summary: Getaround, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting stockholder approval of its dissolution and Plan of Liquidation and Distribution at a special meeting held July 29, 2026, followed by filing of a Delaware certificate of dissolution effective that date. The Board had determined dissolution was in the best interests of residual claimants. Transfer books are closed; shares no longer assignable. This is a voluntary liquidation under DGCL Section 275, with stockholders retaining only statutory rights. Watch for distributions to stockholders and potential residual value recovery.
